items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 30.04.2026. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG a letter posted by a German authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after the date on the letter (no weekend/holiday shift at this step), i.e. Monday 04.05.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Thursday 04.06.2026. That day is a normal working day in Hamburg (no shift needed under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG). Note: this date already lies in the past relative to today (26.09.2026).
